name: wechat-search/search-article
description: Search WeChat Official Account articles by keyword with publish-time and sort filters plus page, offset, and continuation-state pagination.

offset.description: Search result offset returned by the previous response. Use 0 for the first page.

keyword.description: Search keyword for WeChat Official Account articles.

sortType.description: Sort order for WeChat Official Account article web search results.

currentPage.description: Current page number starting from 1 for WeChat web search pagination.

publishTimeType.description: Publish time filter for WeChat Official Account article web search.

readme: # WeChat Article Search API This API returns WeChat Official Account articles that match a keyword. Each result has a snippet with the keyword highlighted, a publish timestamp, and a link to the article. The only required input is `keyword`. ## Use cases - Track how Official Accounts cover a topic such as AI by searching a keyword with the `LATEST` sort. - Collect article links for a keyword to build a reading list or a content archive. - Find the most talked-about articles on a subject in the past week with `SEVEN_DAYS` and the `HOT` sort. - Check which phrases appear around a keyword by reading the highlighted snippets in `desc`. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/wechat-search/search-article" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"keyword": "人工智能"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `keyword` | string | Yes | Search keyword for WeChat Official Account articles. | | `currentPage` | integer | No | Current page number starting from 1 for WeChat web search pagination. | | `offset` | integer | No | Search result offset returned by the previous response. Use 0 for the first page. | | `publishTimeType` | string | No | Publish time filter for WeChat Official Account article web search. | | `sortType` | string | No | Sort order for WeChat Official Account article web search results. | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "category": [ { "selected": 1, "type": 0, "word": "全部" } ], "continueFlag": 1, "cookies": "{\"box_of…", "data": [ { "boxID": "0x2-0-15529639845716571706", "boxPos": 1, "boxPosMerge": 1, "count": 1, "items": [ { "date": 1793685626, "desc": "他说，人工智能已经开始改变人们的工作方式。ChatGPT等工具帮助人们提高效率，也有越来越多的人开始将` tags. | | `data[].items[].date` | Article publish time as a Unix timestamp in seconds. | | `data[].items[].docID / data[].items[].reportId` | Identifiers for the article. `reportId` combines the `docID` with a suffix. | | `data[].totalCount` | Total number of matching results reported for the search. It is the same value in every box. | | `data[].boxPos` | Position of the result box in the result list, starting at 1. | | `offset` | Offset to send as `offset` in the next request to get the following page. | | `pageNumber` | Page number the response refers to. | | `continueFlag` | Flag set to `1` in this response. | | `cookies` | JSON string holding continuation state for the search, including `box_offset`. | | `searchID` | Identifier for this search request. | ## Notes - Set `publishTimeType` to `ALL`, `ONE_DAY`, `SEVEN_DAYS` or `HALF_YEAR`. Set `sortType` to `LATEST` or `HOT` to change the result order. If you omit it, the default sort applies. - For the next page, send the `offset` value from the previous response together with a higher `currentPage`. Use `offset` 0 for the first page. - Each element of `data` is a result box and holds its articles in `items`. In this response each box holds one article. - To search accounts instead of articles, use [WeChat Account Search](/apis/wechat-search/search-account). ## Pricing $0.114286 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged.
